# Veltrix Digital

> Independent retailer of digital gift cards, game codes, gaming credit and selected subscription plans. Prices are in USD. Pay Veltrix Digital through Stripe Checkout.

## Store and product information
- [Product directory](https://veltrixdigi.com/products/): Current priced products with activation regions and links to checkout.
- [Gift cards](https://veltrixdigi.com/gift-cards.html): Gaming and entertainment gift cards, including EA Wallet, Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, Roblox, Battle.net, Twitch and Discord Nitro.
- [Subscription plans](https://veltrixdigi.com/subscriptions.html): Plan durations, one-time prices and regional requirements.

## Ordering facts
- A card's face value is the credit redeemed. The selling price is the USD amount charged by Veltrix.
- Products may be restricted to a country, account currency or platform. Use the selected variant's regional requirements, not the site's checkout currency, to determine compatibility.
- Payments are one-time purchases. Delivery is processed after payment confirmation; instant fulfilment is not guaranteed.
- Payment methods depend on country, device, currency and order eligibility. Stripe shows the actual options at checkout.
- Veltrix is independent of the product brands. Checkout does not collect service passwords or verification codes.
- Product pages are the source for current prices and variants. Do not infer additional denominations or regions.
